Title: Public Preview - On-demand backup and Export in Azure Database for MySQL - Flexible Server

Body.Content:
Using this feature, you can export at-moment physical backup of the server to Azure storage account (Azure Blob Storage). Once exported, these backups can be used for data recovery, migration, and redundancy. You can use these exported backups to restore to an on-prem MySQL server using simple steps. 

Learn more.
